narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed in a moderate CAPE, moderate shear environment just south of a warm front that was draped from northwest to southeast across central Pennsylvania during the afternoon of July 11, 2021. Several of the storms produced wind damage, and a few storms exhibited rotation near the warm front. One slower moving thunderstorm brought urban flash flooding to Harrisburg.
ev: Flash flooding resulted in several cars stranded in water on Cameron Street.
lsr: SEVERAL CARS STRANDED IN WATER ON CAMERON STREET.
